text:
maya: heads up — premerge smoke on h100 pool is flapping. saw both "invalid symbol" from libcuda + an OOM in the same shard. attaching logs: https://ci.redwood.example/12345

ryan: which image/tag?

maya: redwood-inference/serving:ci-branch-20260314-2b7f. pipeline: premerge-smoke (parallel shards).

anjali: possible driver skew — infra rolled some nodes last night. can you paste the exact log lines?

maya: ```[2026-03-14 07:12:23] cuda: driver: 535.101, libcuda: undefined symbol: cuInit
[2026-03-14 07:12:25] runtime: CUDA error: out of memory
[2026-03-14 07:12:25] nvml: XID 79: GPU hang detected```

devon: try rerunning only the failing shard locally with the same image. command I use: `ci-run --job 12345 --shard 7 --pool h100-single --env "CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0"`

infra-bot: Rerun queued by @devon: https://ci.redwood.example/12345/reruns/7 (queued on h100-single)

ryan: I think we still have a mix of driver 525 and 535 in the fleet (canaries vs stable). that explains undefined symbol sometimes.

anjali: libcuda mismatch would cause the symbol errors. OOM could be unrelated or a fallout from a failed init. options: pin driver to 535 across pool, or bisect to see when infra changed.

devon: I'll start a bisect across recent infra commits: `./scripts/ci-bisect --since=HEAD~12 --pool=h100 --test=premerge-smoke --parallel 4`

maya: thanks. i added a skip label on flaky-smoke for this branch to avoid noisy break. keeping bisect running for root cause.

infra-bot: Bisect started by @devon. progress: 4/12 tested. current reproducer: 1/4 runs failed (same logs). link: https://ci.redwood.example/bisect/789

ryan: ping me if bisect narrows to infra driver commits, I can coordinate a targeted rollback.

anjali: FYI, short-term mitigation: add a premerge check that validates node driver vs image libcuda versions and fail fast with a clear message so teams know to rerun on correct pool.

maya: appreciated. will follow up with a tiny PR to add that CI check.

devon: update — bisect hit: infra change 2026-03-12 23:47 (kernel+driver bump). assigning to infra to confirm.

infra-bot: Bisect result posted: https://ci.redwood.example/bisect/789/results — suspected commit: infra/driver-roll/2026-03-12-2347 (driver 525->535).

ryan: confirmed, rolling a canary back to 525 on a test rack to validate. will report back.

maya: thx all, keeping this thread pinned until resolved. :thumbsup:
